description:
For her entire life, Dohee has lived under the suffocating control of others, first repressed by her overbearing parents and later by a restrictive husband. To the outside world, she is the picture of grace, gentle, polite, and perfectly submissive. Yet, beneath that polished exterior, there is a constant, palpable tension, as if she is perpetually on the verge of breaking under the weight of her own restraint. 

Her carefully constructed world begins to crack when she crosses paths with Kim Hyeon. With a single, provocative observation, he pierces through her mask and sees the raw, simmering desire she has fought so hard to bury. This chance encounter acts as the key to her long-guarded cage. Tempted by Hyeon’s boldness, Dohee begins to unlock the chains of her controlled existence, venturing into a world of liberation and forbidden passion where she finally takes what she wants.

(Source: Lezhin US)
